name: ShortSmash
description: Autonomous agent for short-video production: parses natural-language requests, plans the edit, then executes it — AI script, neural voiceover, CLIP-verified stock footage, karaoke captions, and publishing to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X

name: JobAppAgent
description: MIT-licensed open-source AI job application agent (Agent Skill and CLI) that matches roles to one verified résumé, fills employer ATS forms within your rules, and tracks confirmed submissions in a local ledger

name: Shikidan
description: Simple cockpit for any AI agent: one chat runs Claude Code, Codex, GLM, Grok or any CLI agent in separate git worktrees, with cross-model review and plugins

name: LLMSlim
description: Memory component for agents with no model in the loop: stores turns word for word in SQLite or Postgres and returns the ones that answer a query within a token budget, as a Python library or a stdio MCP server

name: Solana Pulse
description: MIT-licensed MCP and HTTP server of pre-signing checks for agents on Solana: dry-runs a transaction against live mainnet state and reports each wallet's balance changes, approvals and authority changes, checks that a transfer or swap matches the request, and returns token verdicts with their reasons; missing data is reported as unknown

name: Volt
description: AI code editor built on VS Code (Code - OSS) that runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Kimi over ACP, with hunk-level keep/undo of agent edits

name: browser-harness
description: MIT-licensed CLI that lets coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor drive the user's real Chrome over CDP, including logged-in sessions

name: Tracekit
description: Separate signer that allows, denies or holds each agent tool call for a person before it runs and records every call in an Ed25519-signed, hash-chained log that verifies offline; Python and TypeScript SDKs, framework integrations, coding-agent hooks and an MCP gateway

name: Rius
description: MIT Python SDK that traces LLM calls, tool calls and agent steps as OpenTelemetry GenAI spans, with auto-instrumentation for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM and MCP, and exports over OTLP to Rius or any OTLP-compatible backend

name: agent-chain-doctor
description: Read-only shell diagnostic for scheduled AI-agent chains; checks launchd, cron and systemd state and logs for the ways an unattended agent stops silently

name: Agent Verifier
description: MIT-licensed Claude Code skill set that reviews LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and LangChain agent code for unbounded loops and retries, hallucinated tool references, oversized prompts, and hardcoded secrets; findings are model-generated and each is tagged as pattern-based or heuristic

name: LumiBot
description: Python framework for AI trading agents that research markets, run backtests and trade through 12 brokers using the same strategy code

name: Pagehaus
description: Hosting for plain HTML sites, uploaded over SFTP or in the browser

name: ContextQA MCP
description: Hosted MCP server for creating and running end-to-end tests and investigating failures, with OAuth browser sign-in

name: check-proxy-tax
description: Zero-dependency CLI that samples a URL concurrently, then reports the 403 retry tax: usable-response rate and effective cost per 1,000 usable responses instead of the nominal per-1,000 price
